shared_evidence.summary: Current canonical synthesis already incorporates OpenAI, Anthropic, LangGraph, AutoGen, Google A2A, NVIDIA, academic MAS literature, FFmpeg/VOICEVOX, and video OSS. New work must focus on validated deltas rather than duplication.

Current AI Army standard uses central management, single-agent baseline, bounded parallelism, context quarantine, typed contracts, explicit termination, independent verification, checkpoint/recovery and system-level efficiency evaluation.

Current video standard uses free deterministic FFmpeg/ffprobe/VOICEVOX, scene-first atomic rendering, audio-first timeline, caption coverage, provenance, checkpoint/reuse, previous-good preservation and machine QA.

Current clipping standard separates rights and monetization eligibility and already includes ASR/VAD alignment, multi-signal highlight scoring, duplicate suppression, semantic boundary refinement, subject-aware reframe and machine QA.

Current TikTok Shop standard already includes first-three-seconds priority, one persona/one purchase motive, evidence-mapped claims, demonstration, review clustering, objections, attention-UI captions, cover alignment, volatile-offer recheck and anti-fabrication rules.
Media commands now require repository-backed re-reading of canonical know-how before planning or execution, including cross-tab/session use and additive mixed-intent read sets.

User requested extensive cross-source research beyond GitHub/Hugging Face, use of paid DeepSeek and upper-tier agents, direct comparison against canonical standards, and adoption of non-redundant improvements after consistency checks.

lanes.objective: Audit current multi-agent efficiency rules against recent official engineering guidance and research. Focus on adaptive agent/model routing, topology selection, confidence/uncertainty gates, context compression/memory, parallelism, tool loading, trace/eval design, admission/halting, cost-latency-quality frontiers and failure amplification. Return only evidence-backed deltas or confirmations, with measurable tests.

Audit video editing and viewer-retention know-how. Compare official YouTube/TikTok/Meta guidance, peer-reviewed multimedia/cognitive/narrative research, and mature OSS. Examine hook/title/thumbnail promise matching, early payoff placement, retention dips/spikes, pacing, scene changes, captions as attention UI, audio intelligibility/loudness, visual safe zones, shot/subject selection, silence/dead-air handling, semantic cuts, and A/B/analytics feedback loops. Avoid fake universal timing rules; distinguish evidence from heuristic.

Audit TikTok Shop strategy using current Japan/global official Seller University/TikTok For Business guidance plus credible commerce/review/narrative research. Focus on visibility, first-second/first-three-second communication, product-card linkage, demonstration, proof, review clusters, objections, offer freshness, creator authenticity, AIGC/compliance, content originality, posting/experiment design, and conversion metrics. Identify any current rule that is too rigid or missing.

Search Hugging Face papers/docs and mature GitHub OSS for practical improvements that remain compatible with free/local execution. Consider smolagents managed-agent patterns, routing papers, WhisperX/forced alignment, pyannote/VAD/diarization, PySceneDetect or equivalent scene/shot detection, subject-aware reframing/tracking, deterministic audio/video QA, caching/checkpoint patterns, and reproducible benchmarking. Separate production-ready patterns from experimental papers.

Red-team both current standards and proposed additions. Find conflicts between official platform guidance, academic results, OSS practice, and repository constraints. Detect cargo-cult rules, unsupported fixed thresholds, metric gaming, coordination overhead, over-editing that harms comprehension/trust, misleading commerce optimization, and privacy/rights risks. Recommend DEMOTE/REJECT as aggressively as ADOPT when warranted.

Produce a minimal coherent adoption map for the repository. Deduplicate overlapping rules and place each accepted delta into the correct canonical doc/policy/read gate/evaluation schema. Prefer small testable additions, explicit source/evidence inventory, feature flags or EXPERIMENT status for uncertain techniques, and rollback criteria. Include exact acceptance metrics for AI Army, video retention/quality, and TikTok Shop lanes.
